title: Sr AI Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to take technical ownership of the design, development and productionisation of AI and machine-learning capabilities within a B2B procurement product. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move confidently from ambiguous business problems and imperfect data to reliable, measurable AI solutions. You will lead the development of models and intelligent workflows across use cases such as supplier scoring, spend analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendations and document intelligence. You will work across the full lifecycle: problem definition, data preparation, modelling, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement. As a senior member of the team, you will set technical direction, raise engineering standards and mentor other engineers. You will be expected to make sound trade-offs between accuracy, explainability, latency, cost and maintainability, ensuring that AI features create meaningful value for enterprise users. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the end-to-end architecture and delivery of production-grade AI and machine-learning solutions for procurement and spend-management workflows. Partner with product, domain and engineering stakeholders to translate business problems into well-defined AI use cases, measurable objectives and pragmatic delivery plans. Design, develop and optimise models for supplier scoring, classification, anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendations and document intelligence. Build robust data-preparation and feature-engineering pipelines for structured, semi-structured and document-based data. Develop and evaluate predictive models using appropriate statistical and machine-learning approaches, including baseline definition, validation strategy and error analysis. Lead the use of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic AI workflows where they are suitable, safe and commercially valuable. Design reliable document-intelligence workflows involving OCR, information extraction, classification, validation and human-in-the-loop review. Establish model evaluation, experiment-tracking and versioning practices to ensure repeatable, auditable development. Deploy models and inference services that meet product expectations for performance, reliability, security and scalability. Define and implement model monitoring for quality, drift, latency, cost and operational health; lead retraining and improvement initiatives when required. Work with backend and platform engineers to integrate AI capabilities into product APIs, workflows and user experiences. Review code, technical designs and model choices; establish high standards for testing, documentation, reproducibility and production readiness. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team capability through knowledge sharing, pairing and constructive technical feedback. Stay current with relevant advances in machine learning, LLM applications and MLOps, applying new approaches selectively and responsibly. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 5+ years of professional experience in AI, machine learning, data science or a closely related engineering role, including experience delivering production systems. Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience with the core data and machine-learning ecosystem, including pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn. Strong experience designing, training, tuning and evaluating machine-learning models, including cross-validation, hyperparameter optimisation and error analysis. Demonstrated experience with tree-based and gradient-boosting models such as XGBoost, LightGBM or equivalent approaches. Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with complex, imperfect and high-volume business data. Proven expertise in data cleaning, validation, feature engineering and building repeatable data-processing pipelines. Experience delivering one or more of the following in production: anomaly detection, forecasting, recommendation systems, classification or document intelligence. Practical experience with LLM-based applications, including prompt design, RAG patterns, tool/function calling or agentic workflows. Experience deploying and maintaining model inference services or AI-enabled APIs in collaboration with software engineering teams. Strong understanding of model performance, explainability, bias, data leakage, model drift and the trade-offs involved in production AI systems. Experience with experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility and monitoring practices. Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including API integration, testing, code review, Git and maintainable production code. Ability to independently lead technical discussions and communicate complex AI concepts clearly to product, engineering and non-technical stakeholders. 
 
 Good To Have 
 Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Keras. Experience with NLP, OCR, information extraction and document-processing pipelines. Experience with time-series forecasting libraries and methods, such as statsmodels, Prophet or equivalent. Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks for LLM application development. Experience with MLOps platforms, model serving, feature stores, workflow orchestration or CI/CD for machine-learning systems. Experience deploying on AWS, GCP or Azure. Exposure to procurement, supply-chain, finance, enterprise SaaS or other data-rich B2B product domains. 
 
 What We Care About 
 Building AI capabilities that solve real user and business problems rather than pursuing novelty for its own sake. Sound engineering judgement: choosing the simplest reliable solution that delivers measurable value. Ownership from discovery through production operation, not only model development. Rigour around data quality, evaluation, security, explainability and responsible AI use. Clear, direct communication and productive collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.

title: AI Engineer
description:
":" Company Overview
 Jetbro is a technology partner for enterprises where reliability is non-negotiable. We build and integrate mission-critical systems across technology consulting, engineering, data, cloud, and AI. Our operating principle is Function over flash. Always. We favour practical, resilient engineering and solutions designed for long-term clarity, scale, and business impact. 
 
 The selected candidate will be employed by Safal Softcom (Jetbros Partner company) and work on-site from Safal Softcom premises , embedded within its product team. SAFAL is an AI-powered Source-to-Pay platform for industrial enterprises, supporting complex, high-volume, business-critical procurement operations across areas including sourcing, supplier management, contracts, purchasing, invoicing, and spend intelligence. 
About the Role
 We are seeking an AI Engineer with 1-3 years of experience to join a 20-person B2B product team. In this full-time, on-site role, you will help develop and productionise intelligent features for enterprise procurement workflows. Your work will support practical use cases including supplier scoring, spend analytics, forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, anomaly detection, and workflow automation. 
 
 You will bridge research and engineering: evaluating suitable AI/ML techniques, training and fine-tuning models, and integrating dependable AI services into the product. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, and domain specialists to ensure each solution is accurate, scalable, explainable, and valuable to users. 
Key Responsibilities
 Research and evaluate AI/ML techniques relevant to procurement workflows, including forecasting, recommendations, document intelligence, and anomaly detection. 
 Develop, train, evaluate, and fine-tune models for use cases such as supplier scoring, spend analytics, and anomaly detection. 
 Prepare high-quality datasets for training and testing through cleaning, structuring, validation, and feature engineering. 
 Build and integrate AI services into the product in collaboration with backend and frontend engineering teams. 
 Translate product requirements and domain needs into well-defined experiments, technical approaches, and measurable model objectives. 
 Conduct experiments, benchmark models against suitable baselines, and communicate findings to support evidence-based decisions. 
 Optimise deployed models for accuracy, latency, reliability, scalability, and operational performance. 
 Explore and implement agentic AI workflows that automate multi-step procurement tasks and support informed decision-making. 
 Develop APIs or services that expose model capabilities reliably and securely to other parts of the platform. 
 Monitor model and data performance after deployment, investigate degradation, and implement appropriate improvements. 
 Maintain clear documentation for research, datasets, experiments, model behaviour, evaluation results, and implementations. 
 Participate in code reviews, contribute to high engineering standards, and improve the reproducibility and maintainability of AI systems. 
 

 Requirements Mandatory Requirements
 2-4 years of professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning, data science, or a closely related role. 
 Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or comparable tools. 
 Sound understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, overfitting, validation, and evaluation metrics. 
 Experience preparing and analysing data with pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries. 
 Familiarity with model-training workflows, hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, and experiment tracking. 
 Ability to prepare reliable training and test datasets, including data cleaning, structuring, validation, and quality checks. 
 Working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data. 
 Foundational understanding of model deployment, inference, API integration, and production performance considerations. 
 Experience using Git and working effectively within collaborative software-development workflows. 
 Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex data or model issues. 
 Full-time availability and willingness to work on-site from Safal Softcom premises as an embedded member of the product team. 
What we care about
 Function over flash. We value straightforward, well-reasoned solutions that solve real problems over unnecessary complexity or novelty. 
 Reliability and reproducibility. Models must be well tested, documented, traceable, and dependable in production. 
 Ownership. You will take responsibility for the quality and lifecycle of your work, from research and implementation to deployment and improvement. 
 Business impact. We prioritise AI features that create measurable value for enterprise users and improve real procurement decisions or processes. 
 Collaboration. Clear communication and productive teamwork across product, engineering, and domain teams are essential. 
 Learning mindset. AI evolves quickly; we value people who remain curious, learn from experiments, and apply new knowledge thoughtfully. 
 Scalability. You will consider data quality, cost, latency, model serving, and long-term maintenance from the beginning. 
About You
 You are an early-career AI engineer with a strong grounding in machine learning and an interest in applying it to complex, real-world business problems. You enjoy moving between data, experiments, code, and product requirements, and you care as much about production usefulness as model performance. 
 
 You take a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. You understand that a model is only valuable when it can be deployed, monitored, understood by stakeholders, and maintained over time. You can balance accuracy, simplicity, explainability, and operational constraints without losing sight of the user and the business outcome.

description:
Micron Semiconductor Technology India (MSTI) is seeking an experienced and strategic Safety Director to lead the site's Industrial Safety and Occupational Health programs. This role will be responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving world-class safety management systems that support a safe, healthy, and compliant work environment. The Director will partner closely with Facilities, Manufacturing, Engineering, Construction, Global EHS, and external regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, Micron EHS standards, and industry best practices while fostering a strong safety-first culture across the organization. Key Responsibilities Safety Leadership & Strategy Lead and manage site Safety and Occupational Health programs. Champion a proactive safety culture through leadership engagement, coaching, and employee involvement. Establish annual safety goals, KPIs, and improvement plans aligned with site and corporate objectives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world-class EHS performance. Maintain compliance with Micron Corporate EHS requirements and industry standards. Interface with government agencies, regulatory authorities, auditors, and emergency responders. Conduct regular inspections, audits, and compliance assessments. Track corrective and preventive actions to closure. Incident Prevention & Investigation Lead incident, near-miss, and unsafe condition investigations. Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions. Monitor trends and develop preventive strategies to eliminate workplace injuries and illnesses. Contractor & Construction Safety Oversee contractor safety management programs. Ensure contractors and vendors comply with site safety requirements. Partner with Facilities and Construction teams to review safety requirements during project planning, installation, commissioning, and operational phases. Emergency Preparedness Develop and maintain emergency response plans and procedures. Coordinate drills for fire, chemical releases, medical emergencies, and other site-specific scenarios. Collaborate with internal emergency response teams and external agencies. Safety Systems & Governance Manage EHS committees and governance forums. Support and maintain EHS management systems aligned with ISO requirements. Prepare management reports, dashboards, and safety performance reviews. Training & Awareness Develop and deploy site-wide safety training programs. Conduct awareness campaigns and leadership engagement activities. Ensure all employees, contractors, and visitors receive appropriate safety orientation and training. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline. Certified Safety Professional (CSP), NEBOSH, or equivalent. Knowledge of Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) standards.  Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team.

Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development.

This role is highly important because PPC acts as the central coordination point between Sales, Production, Machine Shop, Procurement, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, and Dispatch. 
 Key Responsibilities Review sales orders daily and prepare production plans based on demand, resource availability, capacity, and lead time. Prepare detailed production schedules considering material availability, production capacity, and delivery commitments. Release job orders and purchase requisitions as per order priority and production requirements. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Machine Shop, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, Sales, and Service teams for smooth order execution. Monitor daily production progress and ensure adherence to the planned schedule. Identify and resolve material shortages, capacity issues, production delays, and scheduling conflicts. Provide advance written communication to Sales / Application teams in case of expected delay, rescheduling, or quality rejection. Prepare delay feedback and RCA inputs to prevent repeated issues. Lead order delivery review meetings and guide execution priorities. Prepare weekly and monthly reports related to order status, delivery performance, late delivery RCA, and unreleased jobs. Required Qualification BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering Required Experience 2 to 5 years of experience in Production Planning & Control.  The ideal candidate should have: Positive attitude and willingness to take responsibility. Strong ownership mindset for customer order delivery. Habit of continuous follow-up until the task is completed. Strong belief in continuous learning and continuous improvement. Accountability for results, not only for assigned tasks. Confidence to communicate delays, risks, and issues in advance. Readiness to work in a challenging manufacturing environment. Getting things done attitude with discipline and professional maturity. At PressureJet, we value people who are active, accountable, positive, disciplined, and improvement-focused. If you are someone who wants to grow with responsibility and contribute directly to customer satisfaction, this role can be a strong career opportunity for you.
